profiles.name: Wren Tallow
profiles.bio: Songs about your town, sung in other towns.

posts.text: First night of the tour. The inn's cat sat on the lute case and the audience voted for the cat.
New verse tonight. It rhymes 'portcullis' with nothing, on purpose.

profiles.name: Oda Crumb
profiles.bio: Bread at dawn. Gossip at noon.

hangout.text: Behind the bakery counter until the rolls run out.

posts.text: Sold out of rye by nine. Whoever bought eleven loaves: I know it was you, Marten.
Burnt a batch thinking about my mum's recipe book. The whole street smelled like her kitchen.
